deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for billing-service v4.5.1 -> v4.6.0. Reason: values checksum differs and image tag 'rc-202606' maps to two digests in registry. Auto-promotion locked.

mira: duplicate tag, saw it too. Which digest did QA sign off on?

toni: QA used sha256:ddaa...1122 from yesterday. Registry shows a later push sha256:ffee...3344 30m ago.

infra: risk of regression if we pick older digest. But ambiguous tags are unacceptable for production. Suggest pin to QA digest and enable extended smoke + extra tracing.

release-coordinator: plan: open overlay PR to set `image.digest: sha256:ddaa...1122`, annotate release with `helm.redwood/allow-promotion: "pin-billing-657"`, then release-coordinator will run `/deploy override pin-billing-657`.

mira: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/PR-657. CI lint passed, integration flaky.

deploy-bot: Created locked candidate `pin-billing-657`. To continue, add annotation or run override.

release-coordinator: running `/deploy override pin-billing-657` now.

deploy-bot: Override accepted from @release-coordinator. Canary started (5%) in us-west. Extended smoke (10m) and tracing enabled.

(smoke output)
```
2026-06-12T14:02:11Z  health OK
2026-06-12T14:06:20Z  payment-int tests OK
2026-06-12T14:08:30Z  latency P95=95ms
```

toni: smoke looks stable, traces normal. proceeding to 50%. tracker: #DEVOPS-2101 updated with digest and PR link.

infra: reminder: add follow-up INFRA-670 to block duplicate tags and alert on rapid re-tags.

mira: updating release notes: "Pinned image digest sha256:ddaa...1122 due to duplicate tag rc-202606; extended canary passed."

deploy-bot: Promotion completed to 100% in us-west. Lockfile `pin-billing-657` closed. Auto-rollback thresholds remain active.

release-coordinator: closing thread. Artifacts: PR-657, #DEVOPS-2101, INFRA-670.
